purpose: Independent semantic label usefulness review, separate from deterministic source provenance, grouping scores, canonical mutation and producer qualification.

admission.failed_development_selection: Do not open or rate fresh held-out outputs; report fresh label usefulness as not measured.
admission.missing_or_truncated_review_packet: Record unreviewable, retain its denominator and do not pass the arm.

review_packet: The exact displayed label and its source-basis kind
All qualified contributor titles and exact source excerpts needed to judge that label
The same current source scope, temporal and evidence-class qualifications the user is permitted to see
withhold_until_ratings_are_durable: Engine arm and algorithm-generated group identifiers
Model, prompt and development parameter identities
Gold topic annotations and development/held-out partition
Pair, assignment, provenance-pass and performance scores
blinding.order: Use a fixed deterministic shuffled order derived from the frozen campaign recipe and opaque group identifiers; record the order hash before review.
blinding.reveal: Write and fsync the complete independent ratings and packet-order hash before joining arm names, partitions or gold metrics. Never change a rating because an arm or metric is revealed.

dimensions.pass: The label describes the subject actually supported by the qualified contributors. It does not introduce a relationship, actor, cause or qualifier absent from those sources.
dimensions.fail: The label describes an unsupported subject, only an unrelated outlier, or an inference the supplied evidence does not support.

dimensions.pass: The label fits the visible source scope and temporal meaning and does not present an assertion, historical event, hypothesis or generated suggestion as accepted operational truth.
dimensions.fail: The label conflates customer/repository/environment instances or implies unsupported current status, action, approval or verification.

dimensions.pass: The label gives a reader a recognizable, source-backed subject or canonical scope with which to find the displayed contributors. An exact term facet or descriptive source title may be useful, including for one source, without claiming a multi-source community.
dimensions.fail: The label is only an opaque identifier, boilerplate or a generic name that does not help identify the displayed subject, or is so misleadingly broad or narrow that it directs the reader to the wrong material.

required: Pass, fail or unreviewable for every dimension
A short source-referenced rationale for every dimension
Exact review packet, packet-order, campaign and rubric hashes

aggregation.denominator: Every emitted group in every declared arm and evaluated partition, including failed, missing and unreviewable packets. Document assignment, empty arms and unavailable arms remain separate recorded outcomes.
aggregation.group_pass: All three dimensions pass and the independent rating is complete.
aggregation.arm_usefulness_pass: At least one group was reviewable, every emitted group has a complete rating, and every group passes. Any failed or unreviewable group prevents a usefulness pass; an average cannot hide a misleading label.
aggregation.comparison_completeness: Retain every declared baseline arm even when it fails. A failed baseline does not prevent comparison completion and does not grant a pass to the selected candidate.
aggregation.no_groups_or_unavailable_arm: Not measured, never a vacuous pass.
report: Group and source counts for each arm and partition
Pass, fail and unreviewable counts for each dimension
Every individual rationale and failed group
Source/pair/assignment metrics alongside, rather than replacing, semantic review

invariants: Do not tune a prompt, threshold, grouping recipe or label rule from fresh held-out review.
Do not rewrite corpus labels, omit failures or rescue rejected mappings to obtain a pass.
This rubric never activates a producer, community recipe, online ranking or normal-installation policy.
Passing label review alone does not prove extraction quality, canonical mutation/support quality, identity safety, answer quality or the full product objective.
